Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Vintage-Look Runner Rug, 7' 6" x 9' 6", Ivory
Materials: stone
Tie your room together with this elegant rug. A vintage-distressed look combined with muted colors and a classy fringe accent make this rug’s geometric design an ideal accent for modern-style home decor. 7' 6" x 9' 6" 100% polypropylene Machine-made for durability and excellent value. Deep 0.75" pile makes this rug comforting and warmly luxurious.
